description: What is this address? For 1-10 addresses on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism or Polygon: wallet, contract or EIP-7702 delegated wallet; the verified contract name and proxy implementation (Sourcify); a category such as mixer (Tornado Cash), privacy protocol, DEX router, bridge, Safe multisig, smart wallet, lending, token or stablecoin; ERC-20 details, OFAC SDN status, native balance and flags. Wallets get no owner name. Costs $0.01 USDC on Base via x402.
